name: Walking Meetings
title: Convert one-on-ones into walking meetings.
subtitle: Meeting Movement
rationale: Discussion-format meetings need no screen, so walking them converts sitting time into movement.

evidence.summary: Experiments show walking acutely boosts creative divergent thinking; walking-meeting outcomes themselves are largely untested.

indications: Recurring one-on-ones fill afternoons spent fully seated.
Daily movement minutes fall short on meeting-heavy days.
